result:
The research for w189 is done. Result is `DONE` in `.shop/scratch/1-research/result.json`, with notes in `.shop/scratch/1-research/notes.md`.

- **Scenarios:** None accept review#r31. No feature tags it, and review has no feature file. So there was nothing to run red.
- **Probes:** Three supervision scenarios on branch-review questions pass today (11 passed). A scratch probe of `fix_work_item` shows that a Critical line and an unverified-check line each draft a fix work-item. Only fix-now lines should do that (defect D1).
- **Old assumption:** `agents/bdd-branch-reviewer.md:74` tells the reviewer to list Critical findings and unverified checks in `questions`. That is the one file the change must edit. `fix_work_item` and `lists_nothing` read `questions` as given and need no code change. No test asserts Critical or unverified lines in `questions`.
- **Conflict for the plan:** review#r6 says an unverifiable check fails a branch review. Under r31 that check no longer appears in `questions`. Reading A: the fail stays in `status` (`DONE_WITH_CONCERNS`). Reading B: the check still appears in `questions`, which r31 forbids. I did not choose between them.
- **Method caveats:** `tests-of` had no map, so test lists are by search. `tools refs` does not resolve `self.` method calls, so callers are also by search. A plain pytest run collects none of the 203 supervision scenarios, so I ran them with `--whole-suite -n 0 -m ""`.
